answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 51605 Country: AU Title: Name Meaning Inquiry Question: (1) Saauda Tabassum Ishrat. (2) Sababa Riasat Hayat. Are the above mentioned names correct? Please inform the meaning as well. Looking forward to hearing from you. Answer ID: 51605 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 780/650/B=05/1435) Saauda (سعوده): fortunate and lucky Tabassum (تبسم): smiling Ishrat (عشرت): pleasure, enjoyment, comfortable life Sababa (صبابہ): flowing Riyasat (ریاست): leadership Hayat (حیات): Life These names are correct but they are too long. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
